nom: COSRX The Ceramide Skin Barrier Moisturizing Mist

avis.titre: Not for oily skin in summer
avis.texte: I thought this would be more of a water spray, its a face lotion in a spray. You have to shake the hottle. I like the mist, it does come out lightly. You can rub the product on skin afterwards I'm going to keep this for wimter. Will be perfect for the Mid-Atlantic area.

avis.titre: So easy to use and works well
avis.texte: My wife is very forgetful and needed a moisturizer that was quick and easy to use. I got her this one since it comes as a spray and it's been the answer to her problems. She uses it regularly and we've both noticed a big difference in her skin. It looks visibly more hydrated and moisturized and overall healthier. She also hates moisturizers that feel thick or take too long to soak in, which this doesn't. It's very lightweight but effective.She has combo, sensitive skin.

I really like this product, I was hesitant about purchasing it seeing in the reviews that the previous formula was changed once they brought this product back but I had no issues with it, I have combination skin (super oily forehead and nose with dry dull cheeks and chin) and I definitely see the hydrating difference in my dryer areas of my face, given that I already have an oily forehead nose area it can appear a little greasy would be my only con but that's more of a skin type problem not necessarily a product problem. Other than that, it's a great product and I love using it.

I use a lot of co-RX products and appreciate how well they work, but this one has become my new favorite. The mist is super fine and ultra hydrating. I use it morning and evening and sometimes even a spritz are true during the day because it feels so good.

The name is misleading. This is definitely not a mist- the nozzle creates huge droplets and doesn't mist at all. I just spray it into my hand and apply to my face. It feels great on the skin and very hydrating. Packaging needs to be improved.
This is beaufully hydrating and fits well in my hydration focused routine. it does have more body than I expected but still lightweight
Im not sure if mine came messed up, but nothing came out my pump and when it did it wasnt a mist, it just shoots out straight :( i really wanted to give this proudct a try
I really liked this product. I felt like it really did help to moisturize my face. It fit in well as an addition to my skincare routine. Non stick and absorbed well.

Do not be afraid of a few reviews online saying that this is oily. I am an oily skin girl and this stuff sinks into my skin like water and leaves it with the best glow. It saved my skin barrier. I bought five back-ups.
This is one of my favorites! It is so moisturizing and leaves my skin very glowy.
I love Cosrx products but this moisturizing mist is EVERYTHING!!! Will definitely buy again (when it goes on sale) lol
I love the mist, its light and feels norishing. I spray it all over my face & body and wipe it around. It s instant hydration.
I love how light and long lasting this moisturizer is. Smooth texture not heavy at all. Very easy and convenient to use. Another addition to my daily routine.

This was my first time buying this product. I love it so far. Lately I've been trying to find skin care products that can also be used as a way to enhance my makeup to appear glowing/dewey, this product works perfect for that as a setting spray.

The unique nozzle design is excellent and works very well for my dry skin, especially when used in small amounts before makeup to make my skin look even more beautiful. It's especially suitable for winter use, moisturizing and replenishing the skin's oils simultaneously.

My new favorite moisturizing mist. I have owned 5 different mists but this one is the most moisturizing. The only thing is I wish the spray function on the bottle was smoother. It does come out uneven and less fine than other mists I have.
In love with this stuff. It makes my face feel so fresh and so soft.
I use it on my full body for the cold winter air and dry skin
Love it! I not only I use on my face but also on my arms and legs and it gives the skin a glow while keeping it hydrated!

This light-weight spritz bathes your face in a light misty drink of water/oil. This goes on after the makeup and sun screen. It's a wonderful last step that seals in the makeup and quenches the face with soft hydration.
Maybe my new favorite product. It could save my skin this winter.
Definitely helps with the dryness. I use it every morning after i cleanse my face.

avis.titre: Need it in a smaller size!
avis.texte: Love it, gives my skin a nice glow on-the-go! PLEASE make it in a smaller size (100ml) so I can take it on a plane, where it would be most useful!
Just started using this and it feels great in my face, the ingredients and formula really work! Skin is definitely not as dry
I really enjoy that it is a quick hit of moisture that drys quickly but has a lasting effect. I will probably layer this with The Ceramide moisturizer when we have cooler temperatures or at night.

As someone with super dry skin, I'm very picky when it comes to products, especially those claiming to be moisturizing. I was a bit skeptical that a mist would be enough for my dry skin, but this product pleasantly surprised me! I've used it in combination with my regular skincare routine, and also just on its own when I don't have time to do a full routine. It lets me wash my face and go with a quick spritz, leaving none of that irritating tight, dry skin I would usually have to deal with without using other moisturizing products. I even tested it out by spending a day at the water park and spraying this on after subjecting my skin to chlorine and sunscreen all day. It left my skin feeling refreshed and moist, nothing else needed! The spray is very fine and you need much less than you'd think to cover your whole face, so you'll get lots of use out of the bottle. Highly recommend for those needing more moisture and anyone who likes a fast routine or a quick refresher through the day.

I have tried this for a week when I feel like I need a bit of hydration and I have to say this does the job. My face felt refreshed and looked amazing. It's nice for when you have those days of no makeup and want to go natural. Will buy this again!

This ceramide spray it's really help my skin when I'm in the amusement park under sun all day. I apply and spray couples times and follow by applying sunscreen. I'm glad I got this from Cosrx website. . . . Love it so much!!!
Loving the ceramide spray. It's refreshing and a great booster!

I use this product in the end of my skin flooding because of the moisturizing feeling it gives. I also use when I first wake up on from my tretinoin night because my skin feels tight and it gives me a boost of hydration on my face while I'm getting my kids together for school before I start my skin care.
I love the glow this leaves on my skin. I use it first, right after cleansing and have definitely noticed an improvement on moisture levels
Such a great addition to my routine, I use it both day and night after mosturizer. My skin feels so plump.
There's deff a learning curve when using this but it makes it V convenient to use after applying my retinol. Leaves my skin glowy, glistening, and hydrate

avis.titre: Ultra Fine Spraying Mist, Moisturizing Skin Barrier.
avis.texte: CORSX THE CERAMIDE SKIN BARRIER MOISTURIZING MIST 120 ml. This is a protective skin barrier moisturizer in an ultra fine spraying mist. It claims to form a protective skin barrier and also Instantly replenish moisture. The main ingredients are Cremacides, HA's, Fatty Acids, Cholesterol, NMFand B5. It is safe even for those with sensitive skin. I am a Loyal Corsx Customer and have been using their products for years! My ultimate favorite is the Snail Mucin Line that I use Consistently Daily, along with some other products from their various category lines. I was so excited to try this Cremacide Skin Barrier Mist! I have a major issue with sweating, which makes it hard to keep products from dripping and running right off my face. I LOVE that this is applied by spraying directly on my face and neck via spray mist. It sprays on lightly but covers very well. I can feel that is very moisturizing without being to heavy for my 62 year old skin. I definitely need to rebuild my skin barrier as I have noticed with aging my skin has drastically gotten thinner. I have been using this daily for over two weeks and I can feel the difference already. I think that Corsx has created another Great Product that we as consumers can trust and rely on!

Living in Louisiana where the weather is extremely hot, this moisturizing mist is a godsend. I apply it at minimum 3 times a day. Not only does it help my skin from getting dry, it also aids in setting my makeup. This is now a staple in my skincare routine.

I have sensitive dry/dehydrated skin and it's hard to find a moisturizer that keeps my face moisturized for the entire day. This moisturizer was perfect for my skin type. Anything outside of vitamin C & Hyaluronic acid will break em out. I use it with the ceramide mist in the A. M.
mist is really fine and the spray is very smooth and even. it really does feel like it instantly moisturizes my face! my skin is sensitive and it doesnt irritate it at all
I like the way the mist sprays very fine and even. It feels moisturizing on the skin I am enjoying using this product.
This mist sprays evenly and leaves a smooth texture. It's doesn't leave a color or residue. It is hydrating. I use it in the morning and after my make up application.

avis.titre: A Surprising High Performer - Very High
avis.texte: This mist is so hydrating and refreshing. The texture is incredibly fine and silky. It's beautiful over and under makeup. It sprays clear so no weird ashy color. The ingredients play well with my dry, sensitive skin and calms it when it's irritated. I never had the first launch but I'm glad they brought it back! I will definitely have this on repeat in my skincare arsenal.
This pairs nicely with the moisturizer. I'm looking forward to using this in the dryer months this upcoming winter.

Very hydrating! The first time I used it I used too much and it felt really heavy so be mindful that you only use a small amount. I like to use it when my face is damp and I rub it in. I only use COSRX products.
I love this!! I am still experiencing the products and which step they are used. . Since i already use a toner, I use this before and after makeup and also just for a glow.

I have been using the Ceramide Skin Barrier Moisturizing Mist for a few weeks now, and it has quickly become a staple in my skincare routine. The texture is lightweight yet delivers a noticeable boost of hydration that lasts throughout the day. I love how fine the spray is—it distributes evenly without leaving my skin feeling sticky or greasy. I put the spray in a smaller bottle and carry it with me in my purse to refresh my face throughout the day. Overall, this mist is a perfect balance of hydration, comfort, and barrier support. I highly recommend it to anyone looking for a quick and easy way to keep their skin nourished and resilient.

i always enjoy trying something new from cosrx! i like how the formula of the toner is on a thicker and heavier texture for the face. its enough to last through the day to lock in moisture without drying. and it absorbed well and doesnt feel heavy on the face.
Love this hydrating spray! It's feels so fresh on my face. I use it regularly and especially the last step to finish my routine. Highly recommend!
Nice mist with a good sprayer. It moisturizes the skin and keeps it comfortable all day long. The mist is both refreshing and nourishing. It would definitely recommend this mist.
I live in Nevada where it is super dry. I was looking for something I could spray on my face at work when my skin felt dry or dull and this is perfect!
Great moisture boost. Thinking it will be perfect in the fall and winder when the air is dry.

I have been of the mind lately that less is more. Like let me be done. This hits just right! Leaves my skin feeling hydrated without making me feel sweaty in the Texas heat during that day and comfortable and soothed at night. After two week of twice a day use with just a moisturizer at night and a sunscreen during the day I've noticed my skin looks glowy and has been sporting a happy bouncy texture. The first few days though, it did kind of just sit on my face like my skin was like mmmm maybe no thanks and left it to collect in the creases around my nose and wherever else it settled at the time. But after that it was perfect. So I don't think it was a formula thing but a my skin getting used to a new thing, thing. All in all three steps in the morning, three steps at night and I've been super happy and so has my skin. Will definitely buy this again.

I used to love the old ceramide mist that was white and had pink on the packaging. I'm really glad they came out with this one! I prefer this one more, I feel like it's richer and more hydrating and protective. I like to use it before my Adapalene to prevent any sensitivity. I like that it's fragrance free too. I did receive a free product from COSRX to try and leave a review.

avis.titre: Staple product to keep the skin hydrated throughout the day
avis.texte: It became a staple product in my routine. I do have very dry / dull / combination skin and it is hard to find products that work for all my needs. This lightweight spray is a match for what my face desires. It re-hydrates all areas that feel parched without clogging my problematic nose and forehead areas. I do apply it multiple times during the day under and on top of sunscreen and make up. It is truly another excellently formulated cosmetics from CosRX.

I cannot even begin to explain how happy I am that they brought this mist back. I was devestated when I found out it was being discontinued. It is by far my favorite skincare product I have ever purchased. Like if I could only choose one skincare product for the rest of my life it would be the cosrx ceramide mist. I had even emailed Cosrx and tried begging them to bring it back lol So I immediately ordered it as soon as I had seen they did. The Cosrx ceramide mist is unlike any other mist i've tried. With most mists you can expect a little hydration initially, but its usually not long before you find yourself having to spritz again. That is not the case with this at all, it basically feels like a moisturizer in spray bottle form. Like it legitimately gives my skin more hydration than my actual moisturizer does, and it lasts all day long. Sometimes I use this instead of my actual moisturizer, because its enough on its own. You can tell your skin is really absorbing it too, because after using it regularly your skin begins to look naturally dewy and feels hydrated even when your skin is dry & bare with no product on. I'm so glad they didnt change it in a noitcable way. It feels identical, and leaves my skin just as moisturized. I experienced no breakouts or irritation w/ this new reformulation, It preforms just as good as the original, and im so glad its back!

I was really disappointed to miss out on the original ceramide mist before it was discontinued, so I was thrilled to see this new version become available. The mist feels amazing on my skin—light, refreshing, and never oily, even with my oily/combination skin type. I love how it gives me an instant boost of hydration, and I find myself reaching for it throughout the day whenever I need a little extra moisture.
Loving the re-formulated mist!! So nice not having to shake it like the old one (but that one is still so good too!!)
Super hydrating and dewy finish for the face. Feels good on my skin! Color is sheer/translucent. Melts right into the skin
The dream mist. I always keep face mists around. Have experienced many brands, and this is the one you want.

I've been using the Ceramide Skin Barrier Moisturizing Mist for about 16 days now, and I'm really impressed. The texture is milky and slightly thicker than most toners, but it absorbs quickly without feeling greasy. My skin feels soft and hydrated after each use, and I've noticed a subtle glow that wasn't there before. I have dry, sensitive skin, and this toner has been soothing without causing any irritation. It contains 5-Ceramide Complex (Ceramide NP, NS, AP, AS, EOP). Hydroxypropyl Bislauramide MEA (pseudoceramide). Cholesterol and Fatty Acid. Panthenol (Vitamin B5). 5 Multi-functional Hyaluronic Acids. Natural Moisturizing Factors (NMF). All the ingredients are great for strengthening the skin barrier and providing lasting moisture. I also like that it's vegan and seems to be free from harsh chemicals. Overall, this toner has become a staple in my skincare routine. It's gentle, effective, and leaves my skin feeling nourished and balanced.

I love love the new ceramide mist. It spritzes on so well and I can instantly see and feel my face getting the moisture it needs during the day and in the hot weather. Already told friends about it and they've placed their orders. It's so worth it and I can't wait for dry winter to really appreciate it's moisturizing essence.

Without the aid of the right products, my skin is oily and frequently breaks out. I used this as a mist, and it left me looking greasy (but my skin did feel nice and soft, nonetheless). I received it as a complimentary gift, so I gave the bottle to someone who is naturally on the drier end (but not terribly dry), and it works well for them. Thank you COSRX! <3
My skin has been feeling really dry but this mist has helped revive moisture. I use this mist spray before and after applying makeup. I also use it before my nighttime skincare routine. Loveeeeeee it

I love the product formula and major ingredients. It does a great job on the skin barrier and also increases hydration. It is a light-weight formula that blends into my skin prep routine. No reactions whatsoever

I was so sad when I found out that the original ceramide mist had been discontinued because it was one of my favorite hydrating mists. Then I received an email saying you were bringing it back and making it even better! I was so excited to receive this and love the new formula just as much as the old one. It keeps my skin hydrated, moisturized and gives me the glass skin glow and I am loving it!

I'm so happy to have this product. I used to order their first Balancium Comfort Ceramide Cream Mist until it got discontinued but this product is about the same. It gives the appearance of glass skin. I have both dry and oily skin and this spray helps my makeup sit nicely with no dry patches. . Will continue to use and purchase.

I was heartbroken when its predecessor was discontinued. A spray is the only way to coat my always dry and itchy back. The newest iteration doesn't disappoint. It has a lighter texture and ultra fine spray.

I am a long time fan of COSRX Centella water. It has also been calming and refreshing BUT the Ceramide Skin Barrier Moisturizing Mist is so much more! First off, the new packaging colors are so fresh and clean. The application is easy and the spray is even. This also calms and soothes but it also moisturizes like nobodies business! I could go without a formal serum or lotion, let's be real, I would never but this mist could be a stand alone. My husband said I looked 'so glowly' without prompting on how my skin looked. This is 100% a new staple in my skin care routine. I have been using it at night when I do my big wash and in the morning when I splash with cold water and reapply. Love it!

The Ceramide Skin Barrier Moisturizing Mist has been a wonderful addition to my skin care routine. The light mist can be used throughout the day to refresh dry skin, or as a beginning step to a daily routine. I love how gentle, but effective the mist is with my irritated patches of skin under my eyes and on my cheeks. I also noticed some tiny bumps I had on my forehead went away after a few days of using the mist.

I've only used a few times. I start with the Niaciamide serum then snail mucin which is one of my HG. I then use my own vanicream daily moisturizer let seep in and mist with the new ceramide skin mist. This was the missing part of my routine. It effectively seals for long term hydration. My skin feels nourished and dewy without stickiness. Can't wait to use in Winter with full face makeup thru out day. Will update. I have very sensitive and dry mature skin. In my 50s. Loving so far.
Leaves the most beautiful finish. Great for when you are forced to work indoors in the dry air. Really love this mist!

Haven't had this type of product before. Sprays on like a fine mist but feels rich on the skin, not heavy but just can feel the product like a moisture layer. Been using it on angry acne recovering skin and it has been keeping redness down and helping heal my barrier. Definitely a good product to add to the mix.

avis.titre: This is amazing and being added permanently
avis.texte: This is amazing! I love it! So light and moisturizing! Spray to prep face for surums and makeup! This is going to be a permanent in my skincare routine! COSRX never disappoints! Love their products!
This is wonderfully hydrating and refreshing most. Works well on its own, or under and on top of makeup. Awesome for on the go refresh when you need it!

I just got this product a few days ago but have been using it the past few days and I feel like it really fills in the gaps between washing my face in the morning and evening. Lately it has been very dry out, so it feels really good to use this spray in the middle of the day to add some moisture to my skin. Would recommend adding it to your routine!

I was one of the lucky few to try this product early, and I'm loving it so far!! It really couldn't have come at a better time. I'm dealing with some autoimmune issues that have really messed with my skin, especially my face, making it very dry and irritated. My normal moisturizers weren't doing anything to help, only increasing the irritation (it hurts to spread moisturizer into broken skin!), and my skin just couldn't hold onto any of the moisture. With this Ceramide Skin Barrier Moisturizing Mist, I'm seeing immediate improvement! I've only had it one day, but the dry areas are flaking less, the irritation and redness are decreasing, and I'm just a whole heck of a lot more comfortable. No stinging, much less tightness, and finally feeling a little cooler (red irritation is hot, especially in the summer!). I think it's safe to say I'm an instant fan, and as soon as this review is submitted, I'm heading over to order the two new Ceramide creams they've released (and maybe a backup spray, because I've got a feeling I'll be using it a lot). Maybe the whole-body one can help my poor dry arms and eczema spots a bit! :hand_with_index_and_middle_fingers_crossed::skin-tone-2:
I really needed something with Panthenol to slam my skin as I'm using retinol right now and that mist is perfect! I can moisturize my skin with mist as skin care and over makeup!!
